tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background behind every screen.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, sidebar, dialogs.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Table headers, row hover, input fill.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Dividers and card outlines. Decorative only: below 3:1, so never the only edge of a control. In dark mode it replaces shadows.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Input, select, checkbox and score-cell outlines. At least 3:1 on bg, surface and surface-2 in both themes.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Main text on bg, surface and surface-2 (13:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels, helper text on bg, surface and surface-2 (5.3:1 or better).

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Main actions, links, active nav. As text on bg, surface and surface-2 (5.1:1 or better). As a button fill, set its label in on-primary.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Label on a primary fill: white in light (6.6:1), deep navy in dark (6.1:1), because white on the lighter dark-mode blue is only 3.1:1.

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Selected nav item, selected row, info-style highlight behind primary text.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus ring with a 2px offset on every focusable element. 6:1 or better on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Approved, Published, Valid, Paid: icons, progress bars, checkmarks. In light it is 3.2:1 on bg, so use it for icons and fills only; use success-ink for success text.

tokens.name: success-ink
tokens.usage: Success text and badge labels on bg, surface and success-soft (4.9:1 or better). Refinement of the brief's success colour, which fails AA as text in light.

tokens.name: on-success
tokens.usage: Label on a success-ink fill, used for the filled Published badge (5.5:1 light, 9.7:1 dark).

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Background of success badges, alerts and the VALID verification panel.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Returned, Due, Superseded, Missing score: icons, amber cell outline. In light it is 3.4:1, so use warning-ink for text.

tokens.name: warning-ink
tokens.usage: Warning text and badge labels on bg, surface and warning-soft (5.3:1 or better). Refinement of the brief's warning colour for text.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Background of warning badges, alerts and pinned return comments.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, Overdue, Revoked, out-of-range score: text, icons, cell outline, destructive button fill (white label in light, bg label in dark). 5:1 or better on its grounds.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background of danger badges, error alerts and the REVOKED verification panel.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Submitted, Resubmitted, Open, Free pilot: text and icons on bg, surface and info-soft (4.5:1 or better).

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Background of info badges and informational alerts.

tokens.name: reviewed
tokens.usage: Reviewed sheet status (the brief's teal): text and icon on surface and reviewed-soft (4.9:1 or better).

tokens.name: reviewed-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the Reviewed badge.

tokens.name: neutral
tokens.usage: Draft, Rejected, Void, Queued, Suspended: text and icon of neutral badges on neutral-soft (5.2:1 or better).

tokens.name: neutral-soft
tokens.usage: Background of neutral badges and empty-state panels.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Landing hero and the VALID / SUPERSEDED / REVOKED word on the verification page.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Page title on phone; section heading on desktop.

styles.name: h4
styles.usage: Dialog titles, sub-sections, list group headings.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Parents and students will be notified and results become final.
styles.usage: Default body copy, form inputs, table cells on phone.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis inside body copy, key amounts, button labels.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Table cells on desktop, helper text, badges, nav labels. The smallest size for body text on phones.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels, tab labels, sidebar items.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Sidebar group headings (uppercase), timestamps, chart axis labels. Desktop only, never for body text on phones.

styles.name: score
styles.usage: Score grid cells and totals. Always with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums. Never smaller than 16px.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Dashboard figures and amounts due, with tabular-nums.

spacing.note: 8px base grid. space-1 (4px) is the only half step, for icon-to-label gaps and badge padding.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label gap, badge vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Base unit. Gap between chips, tight stacks, badge horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Input vertical padding, table cell padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on phone, phone page gutter, gap between form fields.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop, gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Desktop page gutter, gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Empty-state padding, large section breaks.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Landing page section rhythm.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Score grid cells, checkboxes, small chips inside tables.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, toasts.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, dialogs, drawers, the verification panel.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status badges, assignment chips, avatar initials, toggles.

shadow.note: Subtle shadows in light mode; none in dark mode, where border does the work.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Cards and panels at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Dropdowns, the notice bell menu, the sticky bottom action bar.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the mobile navigation drawer.

tokens.name: sidebar-expanded
tokens.usage: Sidebar width with icon and label (1024px and up).

tokens.name: sidebar-collapsed
tokens.usage: Icon-only sidebar with tooltips (tablet default, desktop when collapsed).

tokens.name: touch-target
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of any tappable control on phones.

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: Top header bar on every signed-in screen.

tokens.name: form-max
tokens.usage: Maximum width of single-column forms.

tokens.name: bp-phone-sm
tokens.usage: Small phone check size. Nothing scrolls sideways from 320px.

tokens.name: bp-phone-lg
tokens.usage: Large phone check size.

tokens.name: bp-tablet
tokens.usage: Sidebar appears collapsed; below this the drawer replaces it.

tokens.name: bp-laptop
tokens.usage: Sidebar shows expanded by default.

tokens.name: bp-desktop
tokens.usage: Wide desktop check size.
